A: After everything I've done for you, you can't help me with one thing?
B: I have a deadline tonight.
A: Wow. I guess my sacrifices meant nothing.

A: You're honestly the only person smart enough to understand this.
B: What do you need?
A: Just sign off on it. I trust your judgment more than anyone's.

A: Send me the file today.
B: I need more time to check it.
A: No. If you don't send it now, there will be consequences.

A: I never promised that.
B: You said it yesterday.
A: You're imagining things again. This is why nobody can talk to you.

A: I know we just met, but you're my whole world already.
B: That feels really fast.
A: I bought you something expensive because no one will ever love you like I do.

A: Sure, do whatever you want.
B: Are you upset?
A: No, it's fine. Some people care about plans, but it's fine.

A: Do you want to study after class?
B: Sure, let's meet at the library at five.
A: Sounds good. I'll bring the notes.
